PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy are popular platforms for selling digital products, but they have significant limitations. PayPal has strict policies and can suspend accounts without notice, while Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have fees ranging from 3.5% to 8%, and they also have their own set of rules and restrictions. In contrast, NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements, providing a more flexible and cost-effective solution for creators in restricted countries. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Google Apps Script, allowing developers to build custom solutions for their digital stores.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy have restrictions on certain countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. These platforms may not be available or may have limited features in these countries, making it difficult for creators to sell their digital products. In contrast, NOWPayments does not have any country restrictions, allowing creators in restricted countries to accept payments from anywhere in the world. This makes it an ideal solution for creators who need to sell their digital products globally without relying on platforms that are not available or have limited features in their countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy have varying payment speeds, fees, and costs. PayPal's payment speed can take up to 3-5 business days, while Stripe's payment speed is faster, but its fees range from 2.9% + 30¢ to 3.4% + 30¢. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have fees ranging from 3.5% to 8%, and they also have their own set of costs, such as transaction fees and payment processing fees. In contrast, NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements, providing a more flexible and cost-effective solution for creators in restricted countries.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy require creators to rely on their platforms for payment processing, order storage, and product delivery. This means that creators do not have full control over their digital stores and may be subject to platform policies and restrictions. In contrast, NOWPayments provides infrastructure sovereignty, allowing creators to deploy their online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This means that creators have full control over their digital stores and can customize their solutions to meet their specific needs.
